summary: A groovebox firmware based on Hortator, with eight drum tracks, up to two 303-style ACID bass voices and 64-step patterns, plus pattern remixing and generation tools.
features: 808, 909, Plaits-based and sample drum models; ACID bass on up to 2 tracks
64 steps per track with probability, ratchets, accents, locks and recorded knob motion
"ORB Remix" mappings, TB-3PO bass-line generation and Grids patterns
Per-track LFOs, resonators, slicer; sidechain compressor and live PERFORM effects
USB and TRS MIDI in, clock in, MIDI learn and USB audio
Four project slots and song chaining; separate Bluetooth MIDI build
